en.t: These pictures are truly deeply moving.

units.source_text: 观者即使不知根由，初次看到，只要其人略解情趣，也未有不感动流泪者。

en.t: Even viewers who know nothing of the story behind them, seeing them for the first time, if they have the slightest understanding of feeling and taste, cannot help being moved to tears.

units.source_text: 何况这夫妇二人身受苦难，永远难忘当年之事，心中的旧梦无时或醒。

en.t: How much more so for this husband and wife, who had suffered those hardships themselves, could never forget what happened then, and whose old dreams in their hearts never truly woke.

units.source_text: 他们看到这些画，痛定思痛，安得不悲？

en.t: When they looked at these pictures and, after the pain had settled, thought back on that pain, how could they not grieve?

units.source_text: 紫姬埋怨他以前不早给她看，吟道：

en.t: Lady Murasaki reproached him for not showing them to her sooner, and recited:
